items.title: Number Blocks Missing Number
items.description: Give your child a head start with our latest preschool learning book that teaches the basics of math to toddlers. Our Book for Toddlers Ages 3-6 is a great way for your little one to learn basic mathematical skills such as number recognition and writing. Missing And Tracing Number Book for Preschoolers is a fun handwriting workbook with complete step-by-step instructions on how to write every number. Our Number Tracing Math Book includes two parts: - Part one: The missing number - Part two: tracing numbers and shapes

items.title: Numberblocks 1-20: A Lift the Flap Book
items.description: "Learn and play with Numberblocks one to twenty. This fun lift-the-flap book helps young children to build numbers up to 20, recognise number patterns and search and count with the Numberblocks"--Back cover.
